metadata.name: CU Avatars - Remove Models
metadata.description: Install into the mods folder. Remove only this custom DLC and its list entry.
metadata.largeDescription:
CREDITS
Concept, creative direction and testing: Satixfied. Code and GTA rig/animation adaptation assisted by AI tools. Hurt reaction sound clips supplied by Satixfied.
Much love to Akittu for giving permission to use their gorgeous models for these mods and videos! Check out their work and show them some love: Expie: https://akittu.gumroad.com/l/stylizedexperiment Milky: https://akittu.gumroad.com/l/stylizedmilky Twitter/X: https://x.com/_akittu YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@akittu
Much love to Sevenscalesdragon for allowing use of their beautiful Dune model! Please go support them: Dune: https://sevenscalesdragon.gumroad.com/l/SSDstylizedDune Twitter/X: https://x.com/Sevenscales_DOU
Casualties: Unknown characters/setting: Orsoniks. Grand Theft Auto V: Rockstar Games. This is an unofficial fan modification. Runtime dependency: Script Hook V by Alexander Blade (download separately). Model installation: OpenIV by the OpenIV Team (download separately). Asset build tooling uses CodeWalker by dexyfex as an external dependency.
Retain these credits and links on the mod download page and associated videos. Private permission messages/screenshots are not included in the public download.

This is a free GTA V singleplayer mod. Do not sell this package or the models, put the creators' work behind a paywall, or offer the models as a paid feature.
Akittu permitted Satixfied to use the free downloadable avatars in games/mods and media, with Gumroad/Jinxxy product links and Twitter/X and YouTube credits. Do not redistribute the original avatar files as supplied by the creator. No purchased supporter-pack source files, original Blender files, FBX avatar exports, Unity packages or Substance Painter project files are included here.
Sevenscalesdragon permitted a downloadable mod using Dune, with creator links. Their stated restriction is no political use. Respect this condition.
The avatar artwork is NOT licensed under the source-code license. The files in the custom DLC are converted GTA-specific runtime assets for this mod. Permission for this mod does not grant a general license to repackage or resell the creators' avatar products. Direct people to the original creators instead. The supplied hurt sound clips are also separate from the code license and are included as runtime assets for this mod.
